description: This file implements event tracing functionalities for the ocudulog logging system, including initialization, time formatting, and duration tracing, with external dependencies on sink creation and log channel management.

classes.name: ocudulog::detail::scoped_complete_event
classes.description: Private class implementing destructor logic to log event duration if it exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: ocudulog::event_trace_init()
methods.description: Initializes the default event trace log channel with a file sink.

methods.name: ocudulog::event_trace_init(log_channel& c)
methods.description: Sets a custom log channel for event tracing if not already set.

methods.name: ocudulog::event_trace_init(const std::string& filename, std::size_t capacity)
methods.description: Initializes event tracing with a custom file sink with specified filename and capacity.

methods.name: ocudulog::trace_duration_begin
methods.description: Logs the start of a duration event with timestamp, thread ID, category, and name.

methods.name: ocudulog::trace_duration_end
methods.description: Logs the end of a duration event with timestamp, thread ID, category, and name.
